subject: plainfin midshipman fish
title: A Fish Hum Kept a Whole Town Awake. They Blamed the Military

scenes.text: A town couldn't sleep all summer. The noise was fish.
Sausalito, California, 1981. Houseboat residents heard a drone every night: like an electric shaver, some said; like a plane engine at full throttle, said others.
They blamed a sewage plant, diesel generators, secret submarine tests, even aliens. The county measured the hum at up to 40 decibels.
The culprit: male plainfin midshipman fish, also called humming toadfish. They vibrate their swim bladder up to 150 times a second to call females.
Hundreds of them under the hulls, humming through the night, every mating season.
The town gave in and threw a Humming Toadfish Festival. The fish never did stop.

description:
In the 1980s, houseboat residents of Sausalito, California were kept awake by a nightly hum they blamed on sewage pumps, generators, secret military experiments and even aliens. It was fish.
The sound, first noticed in the summer of 1981 and measured at up to 40 decibels, came from male plainfin midshipman (Porichthys notatus), the humming toadfish, which vibrate muscles around their swim bladder up to 150 times a second to attract females to their nests. The town later held a Humming Toadfish Festival.
What is the strangest noise you have ever had to track down?

first_comment: Sewage pumps, submarines, aliens... it was a fish looking for a date. What would you have blamed?
